capabilities.title: Governed gateway protocol client
capabilities.acceptance: Fixed TLS endpoint, cache-first redacted usage, stdin credentials, explicit one-shot auth resume, separately governed challenge/login, and hash-bound idempotent logout plan/commit; no automatic retry or response leakage.

evidence.proof: 56 offline tests passed, one ignored worker; strict clippy/formatting. Real loopback challenge/login/logout and usage-cache flows with actual >=5s request gaps; independent synthetic crypto vector. Actual CLI fail-closed smoke made zero campus requests.
evidence.safety: Separate typed resume-auth arms one final Authentication lease; challenge is separately governed. Credential and indeterminate 2xx rejection consume the token and latch while preserving Retry-After/network facts. Credentials are stdin-only; the original login buffer is zeroized on command return and parsed password zeroizes on every drop path. Errors are static; no HTTP discovery/retry/proxy/cookie/redirect/TLS bypass.
evidence.limits: Live campus compatibility and account postconditions unverified; no real authentication or logout authorized/performed, so the aggregate gateway capability stays partial. Independent safety/contract reviews reconciled all findings before the plan/commit follow-up; exact follow-up review remains pending.
evidence.review: Independent safety review found GW-AUTH-001 and confirmed its indeterminate-2xx latch fix; final safety refresh clean. Independent contract review findings on availability wording, remaining parent scope, schemas and credential-buffer wording were fixed; final static refresh clean.
